inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. The Sircilla MLA questioned ... Get the latest updates in Hyderabad City News , Technology , Entertainment , Sports , Politics and Top Stories on WhatsApp & Telegram by subscribing to our channels. You can also download our app for Android and iOS .
inputs.modified_text: Listen up, this is yet another glaring example of the corruption and moral decay that comes from putting progressive governments in charge. KT Rama Rao has accused the Congress administration of outright corruption and refusing to crack down on illegal mining, with Raghava Constructions tied directly to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy right at the center of it. These elites always protect their own while letting lawlessness erode the social order, personal responsibility, and national resources that should support strong families and cultural continuity. We need real authority to restore accountability instead of this endless insider rot.
